body:
3:00 p.m. Took 0.5 mg (pill) on a full stomach..
3:30 Felling very relaxed and chilled though legs are a bit shaky.
3.45 I lay down on the couch thinking I'd have a short nap.
3:45 to 7:30 a.m. NO MEMORY WHATSOEVER - COMPLETE BLACKOUT
7:30 a.m. next morning!!!   I wake up in bed look at my watch and wonder WTF had happened. I see my wife beside me who's also just waking up. We start talking and she explains to me that when she came back from her yoga class I was already in bed and told her I was really tired and just felt like crashing.
Got out of bed feeling completely rested, no brain fog or grogginess whatsoever.
Please note that at the time I had zero tolerance to Benzos.
I'm glad I didn't do anything crazy while under the influence but this is certainly not the guaranteed outcome every time
!
